titel: Commerce Advisory & Solution Architecture Senior Manager (all genders)
beschreibung:
Your Mission
As a trusted advisor and hands‑on solution architect, you guide clients through complex commerce transformations—from early strategic direction to successful execution. You connect business ambition with robust, composable architectures and support organizations in mastering the organizational, cultural, and delivery changes required for sustainable success.
At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive – with ways of working that suit you. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together.
Your Daily Work
Commerce strategy & transformation: You advise clients on commerce strategies and transformation initiatives, grounding recommendations in business objectives, delivery reality, and organizational readiness.
Future‑state architectures: You design composable, MACH‑aligned commerce architectures (headless, API‑first, best‑of‑breed) and integrate them into ERP, CRM, and legacy landscapes.
Discovery & alignment: You lead discovery workshops and stakeholder sessions, translate insights into capability maps, solution blueprints, and prioritized roadmaps.
Platform selection & guidance: You evaluate and recommend commerce platforms using structured, context‑specific criteria and articulate clear points of view to technical and business audiences.
Modern delivery practices: You advise on CI/CD, GitOps, trunk‑based development, containerization, and platform engineering, supporting clients in adopting these practices sustainably.
Innovation & AI in commerce: You shape the application of AI across the commerce value chain—personalization, intelligent search, dynamic pricing, agentic commerce—and within the SDLC to improve engineering productivity.
Who You Are
You bring 10+ years of experience in digital commerce, solution architecture, or technology consulting.
You have deep expertise in composable commerce and MACH principles, with hands‑on experience across platforms such as commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, VTEX, or Elastic Path.
You are experienced in advising senior stakeholders and leading workshops that translate strategy into actionable solution designs.
You have strong knowledge of modern software delivery and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, platform engineering, and DORA metrics.
You understand cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their role in scalable commerce ecosystems.
You are confident operating between commercial strategy and technical depth and communicate clearly at C‑level.
What We Offer
The opportunity to shape complex, high‑impact commerce transformations for leading organizations.
A role that combines strategic advisory responsibility with hands‑on architectural influence.
Flexible working models, including hybrid and remote options, supporting work‑life balance.
Access to a strong global network of commerce, design, data, and engineering experts within Accenture Song.
Continuous learning opportunities, thought leadership, and transparent development perspectives.
Life at Accenture
In this role, you’ll be part of Accenture Song. With empathy, creativity, and technology, we help our clients grow in the digital realm. We bring together talented individuals from design, technology, communication, marketing, and strategy to create solutions that inspire and contribute to a better world.
The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU are the catalyst for change
Your unique combination of skills, personality, and aspirations sets you apart. When distinct talents, strengths, and perspectives merge, the result is nothing short of extraordinary: ideas that propel the world forward. This is why we champion diversity and personal development at Accenture. Create a working environment where you truly thrive. This is your career—we help you shape it exactly as you envision.
Contact Us
Any questions left? Feel free to contact our recruiting team via email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com. We look forward to your application.

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
